query: UPDATE invoices i SET subtotal = s.total - s.tax, tax_amount = s.tax, total_amount = s.total, updated_at = now() FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(round(unit_price * quantity * tax_percent / 100, 2)), 0) AS tax, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS total FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL) s WHERE i.id = $1 AND i.tenant_id = $2
